notes.zh: 四个隐藏入口（获得星系、星系控制者变更、附庸化〔终末者宗主〕、整合附庸）都会拆除灵能压制建筑并调用同一窗口；它只出现一次。
notes.en: Four hidden entries (system gained, system controller changed, becoming a subject of an Endbringer overlord, subject integration) remove aura-suppression buildings and call this same window; it appears once.

scope.zh: 四个触发入口与唯一的通知窗口均已核对。
scope.en: All four trigger entries and the single notice window were checked.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个恒星系的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this star system appears here.
